verdict.rationale: Requesty documents weight-based load balancing across models/providers (requesty-docs-5, requesty-docs-6), latency-based routing that picks the fastest model in real time (requesty-docs-17), and fallback policies for reliability across providers (requesty-docs-3, requesty-docs-4), plus BYOK/keys and spend caps per key (requesty-docs-8, requesty-docs-18) covering the key/deployment dimension. missing for 10: explicit cost-based routing/optimization policy (only prompt-cost reduction via caching is shown, not a dedicated 'route by cost' policy) and independent/hands-on verification of these routing behaviors in production.
